scope: Constellation upgrades after Mona completes Witch's Homework; separate from the two-character Secret Rite.

sources.description: Mona's awakened second constellation grants nearby party members 80 elemental mastery for 12 seconds when her charged attack hits; her fourth constellation grants Hexerei party members 15% critical damage against an opponent affected by Omen.
Character constellation descriptions distinguish the Witch's Homework upgrade and Secret Rite and describe the 80 elemental mastery grant.
